refusal: The service's sealed key failed our check, so we didn't open the tab. No money moved.
method: Each real encrypted share is cryptographically checked once. Production CSPRNG challenges are sampled 10000 times against the resulting fixed validity set. Conditional full verification and decryption failure are separate tests.
limitation: Zero observed successes do not establish the exact probability empirically. The exact probability follows from the combinatorial formula.
